To estimate the mean number of hours that students at a high school spend on homework per week, Marco surveyed 50 students in the school library after school. For the 50 students surveyed, the mean number of hours spent on homework was 8. Which of the following statements must be true?
choice1: The mean number of hours spent on homework per week for all students at the high school is 8.
choice2: A determination about the mean number of hours spent on homework per week for all students at the high school should not be made because the sample size is too small.
choice3: The sampling method is not flawed and is likely to produce an unbiased estimate of the mean number of hours spent on homework per week for all students at the high school.
choice4: The sampling method is flawed and may produce a biased estimate of the mean number of hours spent on homework per week for all students at the high school.

question: A home baker sells cakes. The profit, P, in dollars, from selling n cakes is given by the equation P=14n-250. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the number 14 in this context?
choice1: The baker's total profit if one cake is sold.
choice2: The price of a single cake.
choice3: The increase in profit for each additional cake sold.
choice4: The initial cost to start the baking business.
